{{short description|French biologist}}

[[File:D Meyer.jpg|thumb|Dominique Meyer]]
'''Dominique Meyer'''<ref>{{cite web|title=Who's who|url=https://www.whoswho.fr/bio/dominique-meyer_40129|date=}}</ref> (born 5 October 1939, in Gérardmer (Vosges)) is a French M.D. biologist and member of the [[Academy of Sciences|French Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":0">{{cite web|title=Académie des sciences|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-M/dominique-meyer.html|date=}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Medical Doctor and researcher, she was both director of an [[Inserm]] research unit at Bicêtre Hospital and head of the biological [[hematology]] department at Antoine Béclère Hospital.<ref>{{cite web|title=Histoire de l'Inserm|url=https://histoire.inserm.fr/les-femmes-et-les-hommes/dominique-meyer|date=|access-date=2019-07-15|archive-date=2019-10-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191002113625/https://histoire.inserm.fr/les-femmes-et-les-hommes/dominique-meyer|url-status=dead}}</ref> She has done extensive work at the [[Scripps Research Institute]] in [[La Jolla]], [[California]] and was President of the International Society on Thrombosis and Hemostasis from 1992 to 1994.<ref>{{cite web|title=International Society on Thrombosis and Hemostasis|url=https://www.isth.org/search/all.asp?bst=Dominique+Meyer|date=}}</ref> She was President of the Scientific Council of the [[Fondation pour la recherche médicale|Fondation pour la Recherche Médicale]],<ref>{{cite web|title=FRM|url=https://www.frm.org/upload/pdf/frm_ra2.pdf|date=}}</ref> President of the Board of Directors of Inserm,<ref>{{cite web|title=Fonctions Inserm|url=https://histoire.inserm.fr/les-femmes-et-les-hommes/dominique-meyer/(page)/2|date=|access-date=2019-07-15|archive-date=2019-04-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190423121054/https://histoire.inserm.fr/les-femmes-et-les-hommes/dominique-meyer/(page)/2|url-status=dead}}</ref> Vice-president of the Board of Directors of the [[Curie Institute (Paris)|Institut Curie]], Member of the [[Institut Universitaire de France|Institut universitaire de France]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Institut Universitaire de France|url=http://www.iufrance.fr/les-membres-de-liuf/membre/364-dominique-meyer.html|date=}}</ref> Member of the [[Ethics committee|Ethics Committee]] of the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|CNRS]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Comité d'éthique du CNRS|url=http://www.cnrs.fr/comets/spip.php?article167|date=}}</ref> Member of the Conseil Économique, Social et Environnemental (CESE)<ref>{{cite web|title=Conseil économique social et environnemental|url=https://www.lecese.fr/membre/dominique-meyer|date=}}</ref> and Head of Scientific Information and Communication of the [[Académie des sciences|Académie des Sciences]].<ref name=":0" />

== Professional career ==
Dominique Meyer is currently professor emeritus of Hematology at the [[University of Paris]] XI, member of the Scientific Council of the Parliamentary Office for the Assessment of Scientific and Technological Choices (OPECST)<ref>{{cite web|title=OPECST|url=https://www2.assemblee-nationale.fr/15/les-delegations-comite-et-office-parlementaire/office-parlementaire-d-evaluation-des-choix-scientifiques-et-technologiques/articles-caches/conseil-scientifique-de-l-opecst|date=}}</ref> and member of the Institut de France, whose Central Administrative Commission she chaired in 2019.<ref>{{cite web|title=Commission administrative centrale Institut de France|url=http://www.institut-de-france.fr/fr/ladministration-de-linstitut-de-france|date=}}</ref> Her world-renowned work has been devoted to the study of hemostasis and more specifically to the analysis of one of the proteins involved, von Willebrand factor,<ref>{{cite journal|title= Screening for von Willebrand Disease with a New Analyzer Using High Shear Stress: A Study of 60 Cases|url=http://www.bloodjournal.org/content/91/4/1325?sso-checked=true|date=15 February 1998|volume = 91|issue = 4|pages = 1325–1331|doi = 10.1182/blood.V91.4.1325|last1 = Fressinaud|first1 = Edith|doi-access = free| journal= Blood| pmid=9454763 |url-access = subscription}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|title=Maladie de Wilbrand II|journal=British Journal of Haematology|volume=106|issue=3|pages=777–83|doi=10.1046/j.1365-2141.1999.01604.x|pmid=10468873|year=1999|last1=Fressinaud|first1=E.|last2=Veyradier|first2=A.|last3=Sigaud|first3=M.|last4=Boyer-Neumann|first4=C.|last5=Le Boterff|first5=C.|last6=Meyer|first6=D.|doi-access=free}}</ref> which is the central focus of her research on the molecular mechanisms that ensure a balance between bleeding and thrombosis.

== Publications ==
- On her research: more than 350 original articles and about fifty general reviews, book chapters or didactic articles.<ref>{{cite web|title=Google scholar|url=https://scholar.google.fr/scholar?start=0&q=dominique+meyer&hl=fr&as_sdt=0,5|date=}}</ref> More than 300 communications presented at scientific conferences.

Her main scientific publications are:
*    Meyer D., Jenkins C.-S., Dreyfus M., Larrieu M.-J. Experimental model for von Willebrand's disease. Nature (1973) 243, 293–294
*    Mannucci, P.M., Meyer D., Ruggeri Z.M., Koutts J., Ciavarella N., Lavergne J.-M. Precipitating antibodies in von Willebrand's disease. Nature (1976) 262, 141–142
*    Zimmerman T.S., Abildgaard C.F., Meyer D. The factor VIII abnormality in severe von Willebrand's disease. N. Engl. J. Med. (1979) 301, 1307–1310
*    H.J. Weiss, D. Meyer, R. Rabinowitz, G. Pietu, J.-P. Girma, W.J. Vicic, J. Rogers. Pseudo-von Willebrand's disease. An intrinsic platelet defect with aggregation by unmodified human factor VIII/von Willebrand factor and enhanced adsorption of its high-molecular-weight multimers. N. Engl. J. Med. (1982) 306, 326–333
*    Pietu G., Cherel G., Marguerie G., Meyer D. Inhibition of von Willebrand factor-platelet interaction by fibrinogen. Nature (1984) 308, 648–649
*    Furlan M., Robles R., Affolter D., Meyer D., Baillod P., Lammle B. Triplet structure of von Willebrand factor reflects proteolytic degradation of high molecular weight multimers. Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA (1993) 90, 7503–7507
*    Meyer D., Fressinaud E., GaucherC., Lavergne J.-M., Hilbert L., Ribba A.S., Jorieux S., Mazurier C. Gene defects in 150 unrelated French cases with type 2 von Willebrand disease: from the patient to the gene. Thromb. Haemost. (1997) 78, 451–456
*    Matshushita T., Meyer D., SadlerJ.E. Localization of von Willebrand factor-binding sites for platelet glycoprotein Ib and botrocetin by charged-to-alanine scanning mutagenesis. J. Biol. Chem. (2000) 275, 11044–11049
* - On climate, an article written with Robert Dautray: R Dautray and D Meyer. France and global climate change. Commentaire, 2011, 134, 397–404.<ref>{{cite web|title=Changement climatique|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Membres-a-la-une/la-france-et-le-changement-climatique-mondial.html|date=}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Cairn Info|url=https://www.cairn.info/publications-de-Meyer-%20Dominique--108267.htm|date=}}</ref>

== Speeches ==
* Nature, a lesson of harmony, speech at the séance de rentrée of the Institut de France held on 26 October 2004 on the theme "Harmony "<ref>{{cite web|title=La nature, leçon d'harmonie|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/pdf/membre/sidf261004_meyer.pdf|date=}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite web|title=Canal Académie|url=https://www.canalacademie.com/idm190-+-Dominique-Meyer-+.html|date=}}</ref>
* Academies in Europe in the 21st century: Memory, research and creation, speech at the meeting of European academies, at the Institut de France 21, 22 and 23 October 2007.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{cite web|title=Les académies en Europe au 21ème siècle|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/pdf/discours/s221007_meyer.pdf|date=}}</ref>
* Ten years of twinning between parliamentarians, members of the Académie des Sciences and young researchers, speech at the séance solennelle of the Académie des Sciences of the Institut de France  held on 22 November 2016.<ref>{{cite web|title=Dix ans de jumelages|website = [[YouTube]]|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N_1BzLKX26s|date=20 March 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Discours jumelages|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Discours/dix-ans-de-jumelages-entre-parlementaires-membres-de-l-academie-des-sciences-et-jeunes-chercheurs-dominique-meyer.html|date=}}</ref>

== Distinctions ==

=== Prizes ===
*   Montyon Prize of the Académie des Sciences 1993.<ref>''[https://books.google.com/books?id=Vy0aAQAAIAAJ&q=%22dominique+meyer%22 Comptes rendus de l'Académie des sciences: La vie des sciences]'', volume 10, n° 5, Gauthier-Villars, 1993, p. 485</ref>
*   Claude Bernard Grand Prize of the City of Paris for medical research.
*   Robert P. Grant Medal of the International Society on thrombosis and haemostasis.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.isth.org/?page=Awards | title=Awards - International Society on Thrombosis and Haemostasis, Inc }}</ref>
*   Research and Medicine Prize et the Institute of Health Sciences.

=== Decorations ===
*    Chevalier on 28 March 1997,<ref>{{Légifrance|base=JORF|numéro=PREX9700499D|texte=Ordre de la Légion d'honneur. Décret du 28 mars 1997 portant promotion et nomination}}</ref> Officier on 13 July 2005<ref name=":2">{{Légifrance|base=JORF|numéro=PREX0508597D|texte=Décret du 13 juillet 2005 portant promotion et nomination}}</ref> Commandeur on 13 July 2011<ref>{{Légifrance|base=JORF|numéro=PREX1116819D|texte=Décret du 13 juillet 2011 portant promotion}}</ref> and Grand Officier on 13 July 2016 of the [[Legion of Honour|Légion d'Honneur]].<ref>{{Légifrance|base=JORF|numéro=PREX1618394D|texte=Décret du 13 juillet 2016 portant élévation aux dignités de grand'croix et de grand officier}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Légion d'honneur|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Membres-a-la-une/dominique-meyer-grand-officier-dans-l-ordre-national-de-la-legion-d-honneur.html|date=}}</ref>
*    Officier on 14 November 2000<ref>{{Légifrance|base=JORF|numéro=PREX0004475D|texte=Décret du 14 novembre 2000 portant promotion et nomination}}</ref> and Commandeur on 14 November 2008<ref>{{Légifrance|base=JORF|numéro=PREX0823631D|texte=Décret du 14 novembre 2008 portant promotion et nomination}}</ref> of the [[Ordre national du Mérite]].

Member of the Conseil de l'Ordre de la Légion d'Honneur from 2010 to 2016.
